before.descriptionEn: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
before.descriptionZh: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近450范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。

after.descriptionEn: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 425 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
after.descriptionZh: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近425范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。

before.descriptionEn: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
before.descriptionZh: 舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得减益免疫状态，魔法抗性提升80%，并且每0.2秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转结束时施加强驱散效果。

after.descriptionEn:
Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a basic dispel at the start and end of the spin.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
after.descriptionZh:
舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得减益免疫状态，魔法抗性提升80%，并且每0.2秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转开始和结束时施加弱驱散效果。

驱散类型：弱驱散

before.descriptionEn:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
before.descriptionZh:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

驱散类型：弱驱散

after.descriptionEn:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy unit and then slashes it. Juggernaut continues to jump slash nearby random enemies (including the previously slashed enemy) until the duration ends or there are no enemies nearby. Jump rate is dependent on Juggernaut's attack speed. Juggernaut is invulnerable and has increased attack speed during Omnislash.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
after.descriptionZh:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，对其进行斩击。主宰会持续跃向附近的随机敌人（包括之前斩击过的敌人），直到持续时间结束或附近没有敌人。跃击频率取决于主宰的攻击速度。主宰在无敌斩期间为无敌，并拥有更高的攻击速度。

驱散类型：弱驱散

before.descriptionEn: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.
before.descriptionZh: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击会造成额外魔法伤害。

after.descriptionEn: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will have bonus item potency and magic damage.
after.descriptionZh: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击拥有额外物品威力，并造成额外魔法伤害。

before.descriptionEn: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
before.descriptionZh: 影魔的出现使得周围的敌人护甲降低。

after.descriptionEn: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor and magic resistance of nearby enemies.
after.descriptionZh: 影魔的出现使得周围敌人的护甲和魔法抗性降低。

before.descriptionEn:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for 0.6 seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of 2.15. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. 

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
before.descriptionZh:
影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多20个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续0.6秒，最高可达2.15秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。

死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。

after.descriptionEn:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed reduced for 1.2 / 1.5 / 1.8 seconds, increased by 0.1 seconds for each additional soul that hits it. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. 

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
after.descriptionZh:
影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多20个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，持续1.2 / 1.5 / 1.8秒，每道额外击中的魔能还将提升0.1秒持续时间。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。

死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。

before.descriptionEn: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
before.descriptionZh: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续8秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续4秒。

after.descriptionEn: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 7 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
after.descriptionZh: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续7秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续4秒。

before.descriptionEn: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
before.descriptionZh: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心125范围内敌人将受到40%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。

after.descriptionEn: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Attacks have decreased Item Potency. Enemies within an innermost radius of 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
after.descriptionZh: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。攻击拥有较低的物品威力。最中心120 / 140 / 160 / 180范围内敌人将受到40%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。

before.descriptionEn: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every 3 levels. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.
before.descriptionZh: 风暴之灵每次击杀都会获得一点提供0.2点/秒魔法恢复的能量，每3级也会获得一点能量。每次阵亡会损失2点能量。另外每次获得一点能量时他还会永久获得0.1点/秒魔法恢复。

after.descriptionEn: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.25 mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every 3 levels. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.
after.descriptionZh: 风暴之灵每次击杀都会获得一点提供0.25点/秒魔法恢复的能量，每3级也会获得一点能量。每次阵亡会损失2点能量。另外每次获得一点能量时他还会永久获得0.1点/秒魔法恢复。

before.descriptionEn: Windranger channels the wind to gain 350 / 425 / 500 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
before.descriptionZh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加350 / 425 / 500，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。

after.descriptionEn: Windranger channels the wind to gain 350 / 425 / 500 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage and her Item Potency.
after.descriptionZh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加350 / 425 / 500，但是攻击力和物品威力降低。

before.descriptionEn: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

after.descriptionEn: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit with his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

before.descriptionEn: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
before.descriptionZh: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。开启时获得炽魂的最高叠加层数。

after.descriptionEn: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance.
after.descriptionZh: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。

before.descriptionEn:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take 4 hero hits or 8 creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.
before.descriptionZh:
在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。可以承受4次英雄攻击或8次非英雄攻击，并且被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。

连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1点英雄攻击。

巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱，使其回复1次英雄攻击次数。

after.descriptionEn:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. When destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 pip if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 pip.
after.descriptionZh:
在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。

连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1格伤害。

巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱1格生命。

before.descriptionEn:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.
before.descriptionZh: 击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供20%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续90秒的20%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。

after.descriptionEn:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 15% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.
after.descriptionZh: 击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供20%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续90秒的15%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。

before.descriptionEn: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts 15s.
before.descriptionZh: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的生命值和攻击力为平常群蛇守卫的4倍，持续15秒。

after.descriptionEn: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and pip health there that lasts 15s.
after.descriptionZh: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的攻击力和生命格数为平常群蛇守卫的4倍，持续15秒。

before.descriptionEn: Summons 10 Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
before.descriptionZh: 召唤10个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Summons 10 Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the Serpent Ward.
after.descriptionZh: 召唤10个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位和幻象对毒蛇守卫造成25%伤害。

before.descriptionEn: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.
before.descriptionZh: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚350距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至100，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚承受4次英雄攻击后会被摧毁。

after.descriptionEn: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor has 4 pip health.
after.descriptionZh: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚350距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至100，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚拥有4格生命。

before.descriptionEn:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain 3 Health, 2 Attack Range, and 1 Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
before.descriptionZh:
每当敌方英雄被潮汐猎人击杀，或者阵亡时带着他的负面状态，他们原地都会出现一条鱼；潮汐猎人可以吃掉鱼，永久获得3点最大生命值，2攻击距离和1额外伤害格挡。

潮汐猎人每次升到偶数等级都会自动吃下一条鱼。

after.descriptionEn:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain 5 Health, 2 Attack Range, and 1 Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
after.descriptionZh:
每当敌方英雄被潮汐猎人击杀，或者阵亡时带着他的负面状态，他们原地都会出现一条鱼；潮汐猎人可以吃掉鱼，永久获得5点最大生命值，2攻击距离和1额外伤害格挡。

潮汐猎人每次升到偶数等级都会自动吃下一条鱼。

before.descriptionEn: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
before.descriptionZh: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数。

after.descriptionEn: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility and his attack has increased Item Potency.
after.descriptionZh: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数，并且他的攻击拥有更强的物品威力。

before.descriptionEn:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
before.descriptionZh:
向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续2秒。

目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。

after.descriptionEn:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, slowing them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 3 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
after.descriptionZh:
向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且减速，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续3秒。

目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。

before.descriptionEn: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
before.descriptionZh: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂眩晕目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。

after.descriptionEn: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage with bonus Item Potency and bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
after.descriptionZh: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害（拥有额外物品威力） + 额外伤害，并且短暂眩晕目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。

before.descriptionEn: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for 16 seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
before.descriptionZh: 投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续16秒。每3秒会再造成一次伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for 13 seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
after.descriptionZh: 投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续13秒。每3秒会再造成一次伤害。

before.descriptionEn: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
before.descriptionZh: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Ward attacks apply Venomancer's Poison Sting with 50% damage/slow.
after.descriptionZh: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫的攻击施加剧毒术士的毒刺，造成50%伤害/减速。

before.descriptionEn: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
before.descriptionZh: 创造一个灵魂连接，将死亡先知与一个敌方单位相连。每秒吸取生命值。

after.descriptionEn: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, continuously dealing damage to the enemy and healing herself.
after.descriptionZh: 创造一个灵魂连接，将死亡先知与一个敌方单位相连。持续对敌人造成伤害，并治疗自身。

before.descriptionEn: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.
before.descriptionZh: 死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。

after.descriptionEn:
Whenever Death Prophet attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy and return to her with life. The spirit has a percentage of Death Prophet's attack damage and heals for 50% of the damage.

Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and Witchcraft spirit damage.
after.descriptionZh:
每当死亡先知攻击敌人，一个恶灵会飞出攻击敌人，再返回进行治疗。恶灵继承死亡先知攻击力的一定百分比，并治疗造成伤害的50%。

死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和巫术精研恶灵的伤害。

before.descriptionEn: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
before.descriptionZh: 一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入虚无状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军提升了治疗效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。

after.descriptionEn: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing received and dealt by affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
after.descriptionZh: 一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入虚无状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军获得和提供的治疗均得到提升，而受作用的敌军会承受额外魔法伤害。

before.descriptionEn: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
before.descriptionZh: 帕格纳在目标地点放置一个幽冥守卫。守卫将对任何施法的敌方英雄发射魔力闪光。幽冥守卫造成的伤害为基础伤害加上敌方英雄施法时消耗魔法值的数倍。

after.descriptionEn: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero. Only one Nether Ward can be active at a time; casting a new one destroys the previous ward.
after.descriptionZh: 帕格纳在目标地点放置一个幽冥守卫。守卫将对任何施法的敌方英雄发射魔力闪光，造成的伤害为基础伤害加上敌方英雄施法时消耗魔法值的数倍。同一时间只能存在一个幽冥守卫；施放新的守卫会摧毁之前的守卫。

before.descriptionEn:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
before.descriptionZh:
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。

after.descriptionEn:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit, healing himself for the damage dealt and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna heals his ally and takes magical damage equal to the amount healed. This damage cannot kill Pugna.
after.descriptionZh:
持续施法 - 对敌人施放时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，自身治疗造成伤害的生命值，并获得其视野。

对友军施放时，帕格纳可以治疗友军，并受到等同于治疗量的魔法伤害。这个伤害不会致死。

before.descriptionEn: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
before.descriptionZh: 强化露娜的月刃，使攻击可以在敌方单位之间弹跳。每次弹跳造成的伤害都会减少。

after.descriptionEn: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Damage and Item Potency decrease with each bounce.
after.descriptionZh: 强化露娜的月刃，使攻击可以在敌方单位之间弹跳。每次弹跳的伤害和物品威力都会减少。

before.descriptionEn: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.

after.descriptionEn:
Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has reduced cooldown.

The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.

before.descriptionEn:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

after.descriptionEn:
Supercharges Clockwerk's abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed become slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

before.descriptionEn:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.25% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
before.descriptionZh:
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加0.25%。

发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+4点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。

after.descriptionEn:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.55845% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
after.descriptionZh:
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加0.55845%。

发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+4点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。

before.descriptionEn: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
before.descriptionZh: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。

after.descriptionEn:
Leshrac emits an aura that disarms and constantly dispels nearby enemy units. Leshrac also constantly dispels himself.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
after.descriptionZh:
拉席克散发出一个光环，会缴械并持续驱散。附近敌方单位。拉席克也会持续驱散自身。

驱散类型：弱驱散

before.descriptionEn: Leshrac gains 0.7 Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.
before.descriptionZh: 拉席克的每点智力都会提供0.7作用范围加成。

after.descriptionEn: Leshrac gains 0.6 Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.
after.descriptionZh: 拉席克的每点智力都会提供0.6作用范围加成。

before.descriptionEn: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
before.descriptionZh: 传送到地图上任何位置。到达地点后获得一个护盾。

after.descriptionEn: Teleports to any point on the map.
after.descriptionZh: 传送到地图上任何位置。

before.descriptionEn: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.
before.descriptionZh: 对900范围内所有敌方英雄施加诅咒，使他们在迷雾中显形，根据250范围内树木的数量对他们造成减速和持续伤害。在此情况下树人也被视为树木。

after.descriptionEn: Nature's Prophet and his treants curse enemies they attack, slowing them and dealing damage per second. Curses from different attackers stack. Each attacker's curse has an independent duration that can be refreshed by further attacks from the same unit that applied it.
after.descriptionZh: 自然先知和他的树人诅咒他们攻击的敌人，减缓他们的移动速度并造成每秒伤害。不同攻击者的诅咒效果可以叠加。每个攻击者的诅咒拥有独立的持续时间，同个单位的后续攻击会刷新相应诅咒的持续时间。

before.descriptionEn: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.
before.descriptionZh: 附近的每棵树都会让自然先知获得2%攻击力加成。每个树人也会让自然先知获得若干倍数的加成，不论相距多远。树人也拥有这个技能。

after.descriptionEn: Nature's Prophet's attacks gain 2% bonus base damage for each tree near the target, including Sprout trees. Treants near the target also provide this bonus with multiplied values. Treants also possess this ability.
after.descriptionZh: 自然先知的攻击会根据目标周围的树木数量获得额外基础伤害，每棵树提供2%。目标附近的树人也会以若干倍数提供该加成。树人也拥有这个技能。

before.descriptionEn: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
before.descriptionZh: 噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得治疗。每次击杀单位他都会获得永久生命上限。

after.descriptionEn: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains 1 permanent max HP whenever he kills a creep and 10 permanent max HP whenever he kills a hero.
after.descriptionZh: 噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得治疗。每次击杀非英雄单位他都会获得1点永久生命上限，击杀英雄获得10点。

before.descriptionEn:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
before.descriptionZh:
克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。

骷髅弓手不能移动，需要多次英雄或防御塔攻击才会被击杀。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低75%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。

after.descriptionEn:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and have 2 pip health. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to them. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
after.descriptionZh:
克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。

骷髅弓手不能移动，拥有2格生命。非英雄单位和幻象对其造成25%伤害。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低75%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。

before.descriptionEn:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30 / 60 / 90 / 120s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
before.descriptionZh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得40%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续30 / 60 / 90 / 120秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散

after.descriptionEn:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to 45 / 70 / 95 / 120s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
after.descriptionZh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得40%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续45 / 70 / 95 / 120秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散

before.descriptionEn: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.
before.descriptionZh: 育母蜘蛛击杀一个单位后，她和600范围内她控制的所有单位都会获得持续3秒的状态效果，每0.5秒治疗一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少40%。

after.descriptionEn: Whenever Broodmother or a nearby unit under her control kills an enemy, Broodmother and her units close to the victim receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.
after.descriptionZh: 育母蜘蛛或附近她控制的单位击杀一个敌人后，她和她靠近遇害者的单位都会获得持续3秒的状态效果，每0.5秒治疗一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少40%。

before.descriptionEn: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
before.descriptionZh: 允许编织者立刻发动两次攻击。

after.descriptionEn: Allows Weaver to dispatch additional attacks. Additional attacks have bonus damage and item potency.
after.descriptionZh: 允许编织者立刻发动额外攻击。额外攻击拥有额外伤害和物品威力。

before.descriptionEn: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.
before.descriptionZh: 每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们700范围内停留达到1.5秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。

after.descriptionEn: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.25s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. While the thread holds, the enemy is slowed again every 6s. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.
after.descriptionZh: 每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们700范围内停留达到1.25秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。命运之线持续期间，敌人每6秒会被再次减速。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。

before.descriptionEn: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to 20 stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
before.descriptionZh: 用粘性油浸透一块区域，蝙蝠骑士的攻击和技能对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的移动速度和转身速率。再次施法可以继续提高伤害，最多叠加20次。每次施放还会造成少量伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to 10 stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
after.descriptionZh: 用粘性油浸透一块区域，蝙蝠骑士的攻击和技能对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的移动速度和转身速率。再次施法可以继续提高伤害，最多叠加10次。每次施放还会造成少量伤害。

before.descriptionEn: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.
before.descriptionZh: 陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得击杀金钱一定百分比的金钱。被劝化目标的最大生命值会被设为400。被劝化的单位将提升移动速度和伤害输出。陈自己的单位如果在3秒内未受到伤害可以在全地图范围内成为技能的目标，施放后取消劝化。

after.descriptionEn:
Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.

Casting Holy Persuasion on Chen teleports all creeps under his control to him after a delay. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units cancels the teleport.
after.descriptionZh:
陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得其击杀金钱的一定百分比。陈自己的单位如果在3秒内未受到伤害可以在全地图范围内成为技能的目标，施放后取消劝化。

对陈自身施放神圣劝化会把他控制的所有非英雄单位在一定延迟后传送到他身边。受到来自敌方英雄或其单位的伤害会中止传送。

before.descriptionEn:
Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy.  The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage.  The Zealot respawns next to Chen.

Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a 6 second delay.  If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.
before.descriptionZh:
陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己治疗友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈身边复活。

狂热者技能可以主动使用，在6秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。

after.descriptionEn:
Passively provides bonus health, damage and move speed to non-hero units under Chen's control.

Chen may Anoint a unit under his control converting it into an Anointed Zealot, giving it bonus base damage and the Martyrdom ability. Anointed Zealots can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise. Activating this ability will respawn his current Anointed Zealot.  He begins the game with a melee lane creep as an Anointed Zealot.
after.descriptionZh:
被动为陈控制下的非英雄单位提供额外生命值、攻击力和移动速度。

陈可以祝圣他控制下的单位，将其转化为祝圣狂热者，使其获得额外基础攻击力和殉道技能。祝圣狂热者不再被秒杀非英雄单位的技能秒杀。主动使用本技能会使当前祝圣狂热者复活。比赛开始时会有一个近战线上小兵作为祝圣狂热者。

before.descriptionEn: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4 seconds.
before.descriptionZh: 对一个敌人施加诅咒，造成持续伤害。如果目标没有在4秒内远离初始地点走出足够距离，那么将被眩晕并冻在原地。

after.descriptionEn: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4 seconds.
after.descriptionZh: 对一个敌人施加诅咒，造成持续伤害并减速目标。如果目标没有在4秒内远离初始地点走出足够距离，那么将被眩晕并冻在原地。

before.descriptionEn: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.
before.descriptionZh: 每当远古冰魄通过他的技能对敌人造成魔法伤害，敌人就会减速一段时间。如果目标是英雄，力量还会降低。多个本效果会叠加，并且持续时间相互独立。

after.descriptionEn: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy Hero with his abilities its Strength is reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.
after.descriptionZh: 每当远古冰魄通过他的技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害，敌人的力量还会降低。多个本效果会叠加，并且持续时间相互独立。

before.descriptionEn: Ursa leaps forward 250 units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for 4 seconds.
before.descriptionZh: 熊战士向前跳跃250距离并猛击地面带来强烈的冲击，对附近范围内的所有敌方单位造成伤害并减速4秒。

after.descriptionEn: Ursa leaps forward 250 units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for 3.5 seconds.
after.descriptionZh: 熊战士向前跳跃250距离并猛击地面带来强烈的冲击，对附近范围内的所有敌方单位造成伤害并减速3.5秒。

before.descriptionEn: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike.  Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.
before.descriptionZh: 矮人直升机的攻击会击中目标周围一定范围内的所有敌人，持续一定次数的攻击。只有主要目标会受到致命一击等攻击特效。持续12秒或攻击次数耗尽。

after.descriptionEn: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  The additional attacks can proc attack modifiers at reduced effectiveness, except for Lifesteal and Critical Strike.  Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.
after.descriptionZh: 矮人直升机的攻击会击中目标附近一定范围内的所有敌人，持续一定次数的攻击。额外攻击可以触发除了吸血和致命一击的攻击特效，威力有所降低。持续12秒或攻击次数耗尽。

before.descriptionEn: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.

after.descriptionEn: Increases the HP regeneration and damage for Lycan and all units under his control.

before.descriptionEn: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.
before.descriptionZh: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身效果。自身和目标都获得40%吸血效果，并且双方距离只要不超过1200就能共用吸血效果。

after.descriptionEn: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. While shapeshifted this way, the target counts as a unit under Lycan's control for Pack Hunter.
after.descriptionZh: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. While shapeshifted this way, the target counts as a unit under Lycan's control for Pack Hunter.

before.descriptionEn: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.
before.descriptionZh: 当酒仙的生命值低于50%，他就会获得状态抗性加成，而且他的移动速度每1秒都会在加速和减速之间改变。血量越低，效果越强，从0开始到20%生命值时达到最大数值。

after.descriptionEn: After taking 400 damage from player-controlled units, Brewmaster gains a Status Resistance buff for 5s and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. Damage taken is reset if Brewmaster takes no damage for 7s. Can only trigger once every 15s.
after.descriptionZh: 受到玩家控制单位400点伤害后，酒仙获得状态抗性的增益效果，持续5秒，而且他的移动速度每1秒都会在更快和更慢之间改变。酒仙7秒内未受到伤害会使承受伤害的计算重置。每15秒只能触发一次。

before.descriptionEn:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
before.descriptionZh:
召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。

若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离超过1100，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的20%作为反冲伤害。
熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。

after.descriptionEn:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves too far away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
after.descriptionZh:
召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。

若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离过远，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的20%作为反冲伤害。
熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。

before.descriptionEn: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
before.descriptionZh: 混沌骑士和他的幻象在攻击时有几率造成威力不一的致命一击，并且触发时具有吸血效果。对非英雄单位的吸血效果减少。

after.descriptionEn: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal.
after.descriptionZh: 混沌骑士和他的幻象在攻击时有几率造成威力不一的致命一击，并且触发时具有吸血效果。

before.descriptionEn:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
before.descriptionZh:
挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续3秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的25%。被缠绕时无法施放。

驱散类型：弱驱散

after.descriptionEn:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 4s. Restores 50% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
after.descriptionZh:
挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续4秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的50%。被缠绕时无法施放。

驱散类型：弱驱散

before.descriptionEn:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. 

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them 50 / 66 / 75 / 80% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.
before.descriptionZh:
米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。

来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少50 / 66 / 75 / 80%。

任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。

after.descriptionEn:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. 

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them 50 / 66 / 75 / 80% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.

Experience gained by any Meepo is decreased proportionally by the number of Meepos that have gained experience in the last 5s.
after.descriptionZh:
米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。

来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少50 / 66 / 75 / 80%。

任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。

任意米波获得的经验会根据过去5秒内已获得经验的米波数量按比例降低。

before.descriptionEn: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.
before.descriptionZh: 朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。对非英雄单位造成的伤害减少35%。

after.descriptionEn: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through.
after.descriptionZh: 朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。

before.descriptionEn: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.
before.descriptionZh: 不朽尸王阵亡时会立刻在泉水复活。比赛开始时处于冷却状态。无法被刷新。

after.descriptionEn: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed and is not affected by cooldown reduction.
after.descriptionZh: 不朽尸王阵亡时会立刻在泉水复活。比赛开始时处于冷却状态。无法被刷新，不受冷却时间减少效果影响。

before.descriptionEn: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
before.descriptionZh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。

after.descriptionEn: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.  Enemies touching the wall are struck by Electromagnetic Repulsion with 0% reduced knockback.
after.descriptionZh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。触碰墙壁的敌人会被电磁斥力打击，击退距离减少0%。

before.descriptionEn: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
before.descriptionZh: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去15秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away.
after.descriptionZh: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away.

before.descriptionEn: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.

after.descriptionEn: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources, and Scarab Metabolism is always active at 3x strength.

before.descriptionEn: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
before.descriptionZh: 美杜莎沿着一条直线射出3组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发伤害，然后被缠绕且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of magic damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second. An enemy can only be hit once per cast.
after.descriptionZh: 美杜莎沿着一条直线射出3组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发的魔法伤害，然后被缠绕且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。每次施法时同个敌人只能被击中一次。

before.descriptionEn:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within 900 range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
before.descriptionZh:
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击900距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血，攻击速度，减速抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 

驱散类型：弱驱散

after.descriptionEn:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within 900 range, prioritizing heroes. Unslowable while attacking. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, status resistance, and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
after.descriptionZh:
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击900距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。攻击时不会被减速。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血、攻击速度、状态抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 

驱散类型：弱驱散

before.descriptionEn: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
before.descriptionZh: 每次天怒法师用技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时，他都会获得小型的魔法伤害护盾。每个加成状态独立叠加。

after.descriptionEn: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains bonus intelligence and a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
after.descriptionZh: 每次天怒法师用技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时，他都会获得额外智力和小型的魔法伤害护盾。每个加成状态独立叠加。

before.descriptionEn: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
before.descriptionZh: 亚巴顿以自身的部分生命为代价，释放出一团致命迷雾，可以对敌方单位造成伤害，或者治疗友方单位。

after.descriptionEn:
Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist at the cost of Abaddon's health. Friendly units are healed and have their movement speed increased. Enemy units are damaged and slowed.

Health cost is 40% of the Damage/Heal amount.
after.descriptionZh:
亚巴顿以自身的部分生命为代价，释放出一团致命迷雾。友方单位会被治疗，并且移动速度提升。敌方单位会受到伤害，并且减速。

生命消耗为伤害/治疗量的40%。

before.descriptionEn: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.
before.descriptionZh: 亚巴顿打击一个敌人，使其受到寒心诅咒的作用，被减速，并且持续受到伤害，同时所有攻击目标的单位将提升攻击速度。对建筑的持续伤害减少100%。

after.descriptionEn: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Abaddon gains 1.5x the attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.
after.descriptionZh: 亚巴顿打击一个敌人，使其受到寒心诅咒的作用，被减速，并且持续受到伤害，同时所有攻击目标的单位将提升攻击速度。亚巴顿获得1.5倍攻击速度提升。对建筑的持续伤害减少%tower_dps_pct%%。

before.descriptionEn: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 29.5% if they are below 40% HP.
before.descriptionZh: 对敌人造成伤害时会施加凋零迷雾的负面效果，持续5秒。受作用敌人如果血量低于40%，那么生命回复会降低29.5%。

after.descriptionEn:
Damaging enemies reduces their Health Restoration for 5s. The lower the enemy's HP, the stronger the Health restoration reduction effect. Minimum effect of 10% at full health. Maximum effect at zero health.

Does not apply from item damage.
after.descriptionZh:
对敌人造成伤害会降低他们的生命回复，持续5秒。敌人的生命值月底，生命回复的降低效果越强。最低为满血时的10%。血量为零时效果最高。

来自物品的伤害不会施加。

before.descriptionEn:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After 6 seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
before.descriptionZh:
凤凰十分乐意终结自己现在的生命来换取重生。将自己变为一颗燃烧的恒星，灼烧附近一大片区域内的敌人。恒星受到敌方英雄一定次数的攻击后将会被摧毁。经过6秒后恒星将会爆炸，眩晕周围所有敌人。而凤凰的生命和魔法值都会回到满状态，并且所有技能的冷却时间都会刷新。

驱散类型：强驱散

after.descriptionEn:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun has pip health. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the sun. After 6 seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
after.descriptionZh:
凤凰十分乐意终结自己现在的生命来换取重生。将自己变为一颗燃烧的恒星，灼烧附近一大片区域内的敌人。恒星拥有若干格生命。非英雄单位和幻象对恒星造成25%伤害。经过6秒后恒星将会爆炸，眩晕周围所有敌人。而凤凰的生命和魔法值都会回到满状态，并且所有技能的冷却时间都会刷新。

驱散类型：强驱散

before.descriptionEn: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.
before.descriptionZh: 友方英雄传送后会临时获得承受伤害降低和移动速度加成。友军通过恶魔之扉传送后会获得2倍加成。

after.descriptionEn: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain a Physical Damage Barrier based on their max health and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.
after.descriptionZh: 友方英雄传送后会临时获得移动速度加成和基于他们最大生命值的物理护盾。友军通过恶魔之扉传送后会获得2倍加成。

before.descriptionEn: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.
before.descriptionZh: 打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法3.5秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过1500。

after.descriptionEn: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 / 3.25 / 3 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.
after.descriptionZh: 打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法3.5 / 3.25 / 3秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过1500。

before.descriptionEn: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
before.descriptionZh: 齐天大圣的攻击唤醒了金箍棒的力量。连续攻击四次同个敌方英雄后，齐天大圣的下4次攻击得到加强，拥有攻击力加成和吸血效果。

after.descriptionEn: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the number of required hits on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
after.descriptionZh: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the number of required hits on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.

before.descriptionEn:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
before.descriptionZh:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。

after.descriptionEn:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes. Attacks have decreased Item Potency.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
after.descriptionZh:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。攻击的物品威力有所降低。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。

before.descriptionEn:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
before.descriptionZh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。

after.descriptionEn:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the phantom.
after.descriptionZh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

非英雄单位和幻象对幻影造成25%伤害。

before.descriptionEn: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.
before.descriptionZh: 虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，对沿途的所有敌人造成伤害。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成1.25秒减速，然后引爆。

after.descriptionEn: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path with bonus item potency. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.
after.descriptionZh: 虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，攻击沿途的所有敌人，并带有额外物品威力。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成1.25秒减速，然后引爆。

before.descriptionEn: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by 2.
before.descriptionZh: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为2倍。

after.descriptionEn: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time.
after.descriptionZh: 森海飞霞暂时获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。

before.descriptionEn:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.
before.descriptionZh:
玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。

所有友方信使被动获得3级额外等级和1点额外生命。

after.descriptionEn:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 extra pip.
after.descriptionZh:
玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。

所有友方信使被动获得3级额外等级和1格额外生命。

before.descriptionEn:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
before.descriptionZh:
獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

after.descriptionEn:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns enemies and deals 300 + 100% STR damage. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
after.descriptionZh:
獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和300+100%力量值的伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

before.descriptionEn: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 3s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and -20% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
before.descriptionZh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续3秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加-20%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

after.descriptionEn: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 2.25s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and -20% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
after.descriptionZh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续2.25秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加-20%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

before.descriptionEn:
Use: Whoopsie
Propels your hero forward 400 units. Leaves a 250 radius stink cloud behind for 3 seconds that slows enemies by -30%.
before.descriptionZh:
使用：噗
把英雄向前推动400距离。在身后留下一团250范围的臭云，持续3秒，使敌人减速-30%。

after.descriptionEn:
Use: Whoopsie
Propels your hero forward 400 units. Leaves a 300 radius stink cloud behind for 3 seconds that slows enemies by -35%.
after.descriptionZh:
使用：噗
把英雄向前推动400距离。在身后留下一团300范围的臭云，持续3秒，使敌人减速-35%。

before.descriptionEn:
Use: Saddle Up
Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for 10 seconds. 1.5s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than 20 dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
before.descriptionZh:
使用：上车
召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续10秒。上车1.5秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过20点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

after.descriptionEn:
Use: Saddle Up
Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for 15 seconds. 1.5s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than 20 dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
after.descriptionZh:
使用：上车
召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续15秒。上车1.5秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过20点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

before.descriptionEn: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
before.descriptionZh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击800距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的100%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again.
after.descriptionZh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击800距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的100%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。

before.descriptionEn:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
before.descriptionZh:
凯进入不可控制的状态，持续1秒，0.2秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。

如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。

after.descriptionEn:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal a fixed damage attack based on the target's max health with enhanced lifesteal.
after.descriptionZh:
凯进入不可控制的状态，持续1秒，0.2秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。

如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且具有增强的吸血效果。

before.descriptionEn: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
before.descriptionZh: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。

after.descriptionEn: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks with reduced damage and Item Potency.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
after.descriptionZh: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次，重复的攻击具有较低的伤害和物品威力。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。

before.descriptionEn: Largo plays a song that deals 20 / 30 / 40 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
before.descriptionZh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成20 / 30 / 40点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。

after.descriptionEn: Largo plays a song that deals 24 / 37 / 50 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
after.descriptionZh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成24 / 37 / 50点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Overwhelming Blink
 Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 50% movement speed slow and 50 attack speed slow for 6 seconds. 

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：盛势闪光
传送到最远1200距离的位置。

传送后，800范围内所有敌人受到100 + 50%力量值的瞬时伤害，并且额外持续受到总计为100%力量值的伤害，被减缓50%移动速度，降低50攻击速度，持续6秒。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，盛势闪光将在3秒内无法使用。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Overwhelming Blink
 Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 35% movement speed slow and 70 attack speed slow for 4.5 seconds. 

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：盛势闪光
传送到最远1200距离的位置。

传送后，800范围内所有敌人受到100 + 50%力量值的瞬时伤害，并且额外持续受到总计为100%力量值的伤害，被减缓35%移动速度，降低70攻击速度，持续4.5秒。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，盛势闪光将在3秒内无法使用。

 Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take 50 damage on impact, and be slowed by -15% and take 15 damage every 1s for 5 seconds. Radius 300.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：投掷榴弹
向目标区域投掷一枚榴弹。区域内敌人被击中时受到50点伤害，减速-15%并且每1秒受到15点伤害，持续5秒。

after.descriptionEn:

 下个对敌人施放的单体技能会单独对目标造成150点额外伤害，并且减缓30%移动速度，持续3秒。

下个对敌人施放的单体技能会单独对目标造成130点额外伤害，并且减缓40%移动速度，持续2秒。

Passive: Damage Block
Gives a 100% chance to block 30 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 20 damage on ranged.

Has a 50% chance to block damage from creeps.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：伤害格挡
近战英雄有100%几率格挡30点伤害，远程英雄为20点伤害。

有50%几率格挡来自非英雄单位的伤害。

提供25%移动速度加成，50%转身速率加成和无视地形的移动，持续12秒。经过树木时会导致树木被摧毁。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Life Essence
 Increases your current and max health by 240 for 10 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：生命精华
当前生命和最大生命提升240点，持续10秒。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Life Essence
 Increases your current and max health by 240 for 14 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：生命精华
当前生命和最大生命提升240点，持续14秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Lesser Avatar
Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage for 2s. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
before.descriptionZh:
主动：天仙下凡
施加弱驱散。提供60%魔法抗性加成，并且免疫反弹和纯粹伤害，持续2秒。持续时间内敌方技能的负面效果不会生效。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Lesser Avatar
Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage for 3s. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
after.descriptionZh:
主动：天仙下凡
施加弱驱散。提供60%魔法抗性加成，并且免疫反弹和纯粹伤害，持续3秒。持续时间内敌方技能的负面效果不会生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Chipper
Every time you are attacked, you return 30 damage to heroes and 15 damage to creeps.

被动：碎裂
每次受到攻击时，反弹30点伤害至英雄，15点伤害至非英雄单位。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Chipper
Every time you are attacked, you return 40 damage to heroes and 20 damage to creeps.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：碎裂
每次受到攻击时，反弹40点伤害至英雄，20点伤害至非英雄单位。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for 5 HP on each attack.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：吸血
攻击者每次攻击都将回复5点生命值。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for 7 HP on each attack.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：吸血
攻击者每次攻击都将回复7点生命值。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Ceremonial Aura
Lowers enemy Status Resistance by 10% and Magic Resistance by 10%.

Radius: 1200
before.descriptionZh:
被动：祭礼光环
降低敌人10%状态抗性和10%魔法抗性。

作用范围：1200

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Ceremonial Aura
Lowers enemy Status Resistance by 10% and Magic Resistance by 10%.

Radius: 850

被动：祭礼光环
降低敌人10%状态抗性和10%魔法抗性。

作用范围：850

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Bottled Lightning
 Zaps 2 enemy targets within 700 range, dealing 70 damage and a 40% slow for 0.4 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：瓶装闪电
电击700范围内2个敌方单位，造成70点伤害，并减缓40%移动速度，持续0.4秒。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Bottled Lightning
 Zaps 2 enemy targets within 700 range, dealing 90 damage and a 40% slow for 0.4 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：瓶装闪电
电击700范围内2个敌方单位，造成90点伤害，并减缓40%移动速度，持续0.4秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Dark Mercy
Your attacks deal 3 more damage to enemies for each 7% HP they are missing.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：暗黑之仁
敌人每损失7%生命值，对其发动攻击就会额外造成3点伤害。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Dark Mercy
Your attacks deal 7 more damage to enemies for each 10% HP they are missing.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：暗黑之仁
敌人每损失10%生命值，对其发动攻击就会额外造成7点伤害。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Vault
Propels your hero forward 300 units. Tumbler's Toy gets disabled for 3 seconds if its owner receives damage from a player source.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：跳跃
使自身向前推进300距离。拥有者在3秒内受到来自玩家的伤害将无法使用杂技玩具。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Vault
Propels your hero forward 350 units. Tumbler's Toy gets disabled for 3 seconds if its owner receives damage from a player source.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：跳跃
使自身向前推进350距离。拥有者在3秒内受到来自玩家的伤害将无法使用杂技玩具。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Verdurous Dale
  Target the ground with a 400 radius. Provides health regeneration to all allied units while they are in the area of effect equal to 8 + 25% of the caster's health regeneration at the time of casting. Lasts 8 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：盎然生机
对400范围的地面施放。对作用范围内所有友方单位提供+8点/秒生命恢复 + 25%施法者施法时生命恢复。持续8秒。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Verdurous Dale
  Target the ground with a 400 radius. Provides health regeneration to all allied units while they are in the area of effect equal to 3 + 25% of the caster's health regeneration at the time of casting. Lasts 8 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：盎然生机
对400范围的地面施放。对作用范围内所有友方单位提供+3点/秒生命恢复 + 25%施法者施法时生命恢复。持续8秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Rites of Eloshar
Each time the wearer is attacked, they gain a stack of 0.4 mana regen, up to 5 stacks. Stacks last for 5 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：埃罗莎仪式
每次佩戴者被攻击时都会获得一个0.4点/秒魔法恢复的叠加效果，最多叠加5次。每个叠加效果持续5秒。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Rites of Eloshar
Each time the wearer is attacked, they gain a stack of 0.4 mana regen, up to 8 stacks. Stacks last for 6 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：埃罗莎仪式
每次佩戴者被攻击时都会获得一个0.4点/秒魔法恢复的叠加效果，最多叠加8次。每个叠加效果持续6秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Imbrue
 Consume health to temporarily gain 25 damage for 8 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：浸血
消耗生命值，临时获得25点攻击力。持续8秒。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Imbrue
 Consume health to temporarily gain 30 damage for 10 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：浸血
消耗生命值，临时获得30点攻击力。持续10秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Phantom Critical
Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal an additional 80% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：幻影暴击
每次攻击都有30%几率造成额外的魔法伤害，数值为攻击伤害的80%。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Ghastly Strike
Grants each attack a 15% chance to deal an additional 50% of the attack's damage as bonus magical damage.
after.descriptionZh:
Passive: Ghastly Strike
Grants each attack a 15% chance to deal an additional 50% of the attack's damage as bonus magical damage.

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Boldness
 Grants 20 attack speed as long as there are enemy heroes within 1200 units.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：英勇
1200范围内只要有敌方英雄就提供20 攻击速度。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Boldness
 Grants 26 attack speed as long as there are enemy heroes within 1200 units.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：英勇
1200范围内只要有敌方英雄就提供26 攻击速度。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Bubbled Up
 Equipped Hero has a 100 HP Barrier against enemy damage. Barrier fully regenerates after not receiving damage for 8 seconds. Self-inflicted damage bypasses the barrier.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：冒泡
装备的英雄拥有一个可吸收敌方伤害的100点生命的护盾。 8秒内没有受到伤害后，护盾将恢复至满血。护盾不会吸收自残伤害。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Bubbled Up
 Equipped Hero has a 125 HP Barrier against enemy damage. Barrier fully regenerates after not receiving damage for 8 seconds. Self-inflicted damage bypasses the barrier.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：冒泡
装备的英雄拥有一个可吸收敌方伤害的125点生命的护盾。 8秒内没有受到伤害后，护盾将恢复至满血。护盾不会吸收自残伤害。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Magical Damage Block
 Every 12s, blocks up to 300 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：魔法伤害抵挡
 每隔12秒抵挡300点魔法伤害，只抵挡超过75点的伤害

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Magical Damage Block
 Every 10s, blocks up to 300 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：魔法伤害抵挡
 每隔10秒抵挡300点魔法伤害，只抵挡超过75点的伤害

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Reverberate
 After taking 220 damage from any source, the wearer fires a projectile at up to 2 random enemies in a 600 radius, prioritizing heroes, that deal 90 physical damage and slow the targets movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.2s.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：回荡
受到任意来源的220点伤害后，佩戴者对附近600范围内最多2个随机敌人发射一个弹道，以英雄优先，造成90点物理伤害并降低目标100%移动和攻击速度，持续0.2秒。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Reverberate
 After taking 220 damage from any source, the wearer fires a projectile at up to 2 random enemies in a 600 radius, prioritizing heroes, that deal 110 physical damage and slow the targets movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.2s.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：回荡
受到任意来源的220点伤害后，佩戴者对附近600范围内最多2个随机敌人发射一个弹道，以英雄优先，造成110点物理伤害并降低目标100%移动和攻击速度，持续0.2秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Use: Place Banner
 Creates a banner at the target location. Lane creeps in the area of effect become damage immune while the Banner is up. Lasts 120 seconds.

 Can be destroyed. Melee hero attacks deal 2x damage to the banner.
before.descriptionZh:
使用：放置战旗
在目标地点创造一面旗帜。战旗立起后作用范围内的小兵将免疫伤害。战旗持续120秒。

可以被摧毁。近战英雄对战旗造成2倍伤害。

after.descriptionEn:
Use: Place Banner
 Creates a banner at the target location. Lane creeps in the area of effect become damage immune while the Banner is up. Lasts 120 seconds.

 Can be destroyed. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the banner.
after.descriptionZh:
Use: Place Banner
 Creates a banner at the target location. Lane creeps in the area of effect become damage immune while the Banner is up. Lasts 120 seconds.

 Can be destroyed. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the banner.

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Relentless
Increases slow resistance by 50%. This bonus is reduced by 10% for every enemy hero within the wearer's attack radius.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：不屈
减速抗性提升50%。佩戴者的攻击距离内每出现一名敌方英雄就会使这个加成效果减少10%。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Relentless
Increases slow resistance by 60%. This bonus is reduced by 12% for every enemy hero within the wearer's attack radius.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：不屈
减速抗性提升60%。佩戴者的攻击距离内每出现一名敌方英雄就会使这个加成效果减少12%。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Bottoms Up
Restores 70 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana over 6 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Fill Up
Cooldown Speed of Mana Draught is increased by 30% while in water.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：一饮而尽
在6秒内回复70点魔法 + 3%施法者最大魔法值。承受来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害会使效果提前结束。

按住Ctrl键可以对友方英雄使用。

被动：填补
站立在水里时魔力药水的冷却速度增加30%。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Bottoms Up
Restores 90 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana over 6 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Fill Up
Cooldown Speed of Mana Draught is increased by 30% while in water.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：一饮而尽
在6秒内回复90点魔法 + 3%施法者最大魔法值。承受来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害会使效果提前结束。

按住Ctrl键可以对友方英雄使用。

被动：填补
站立在水里时魔力药水的冷却速度增加30%。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Hobble
Hits an enemy for 25 damage, then slows them by 50% and reduces Health Restoration by 40% for 4 seconds. The slow gradually fades over the duration of the spell.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：蹒跚
击中敌人时造成25点伤害，然后减缓他们50%移动速度，生命回复减少40%，持续4秒。减速效果会在技能持续时间内逐渐减弱。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Hobble
Hits an enemy for 25 damage, then slows them by 65% and reduces Health Restoration by 40% for 4 seconds. The slow gradually fades over the duration of the spell.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：蹒跚
击中敌人时造成25点伤害，然后减缓他们65%移动速度，生命回复减少40%，持续4秒。减速效果会在技能持续时间内逐渐减弱。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Beat the Crowd
 Your next attack deals an additional 120 magic damage and splashes to units within 250 units for 50% of the original attack's damage plus the additional magic damage.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：殴击人群
下次攻击会额外造成120点魔法伤害，并溅射给250范围内所有敌人，造成攻击伤害和额外魔法伤害的50%。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Beat the Crowd
 Your next attack deals an additional 40 magic damage and splashes to units within 250 units for 60% of the original attack's damage plus the additional magic damage.

下次攻击会额外造成40点魔法伤害，并溅射给250范围内所有敌人，造成攻击伤害和额外魔法伤害的60%。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Burn Through
 Instances of magic damage from spells over 60 ignites enemies, causing them to take 80 magic damage over 6 seconds. Burn damage against non-hero targets is decreased by 50%.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：烧蚀
单次魔法伤害超过60点会使敌人着火，使他们在6秒内受到80点魔法伤害。对非英雄目标的烧蚀伤害减少50%。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Burn Through
 Instances of magic damage from spells over 60 ignites enemies, causing them to take 75 magic damage over 6 seconds. Burn damage against non-hero targets is decreased by 50%.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：烧蚀
单次魔法伤害超过60点会使敌人着火，使他们在6秒内受到75点魔法伤害。对非英雄目标的烧蚀伤害减少50%。

 Attacks have a 20% chance to have True Strike and deal 8% of the target's current health as bonus physical damage. Deals a flat bonus of 200 against Roshan.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：悍劲
攻击拥有20%几率触发克敌机先，并且造成额外物理伤害，数值为8%目标当前生命值。攻击对肉山触发时总是造成固定200点额外伤害。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Gut 'Em
 Attacks have a 30% chance to have True Strike and deal 10% of the target's current health as bonus physical damage. Deals a flat bonus of 200 against Roshan.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：悍劲
攻击拥有30%几率触发克敌机先，并且造成额外物理伤害，数值为10%目标当前生命值。攻击对肉山触发时总是造成固定200点额外伤害。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: One for the Road
Increases movement speed of all allied units by 10% in a 1000 unit radius around the caster for 6 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:

提升施法者附近1000范围内所有友方单位10%的移动速度，持续6秒。

提升施法者附近1000范围内所有友方单位10%的移动速度，持续8秒。

Spreads pollen on all enemy units in a 900 unit radius for 9 seconds, decreasing their health restoration by 50% and dealing damage per second, the total equal to 9% of their maximum health.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：授粉
把花粉播撒给所有900范围内的所有敌方单位，降低50%生命回复，持续9秒，并且在持续时间内造成每秒伤害，总数值为他们的9%最大生命值。

after.descriptionEn:

Passive: Blood Invocation
 Spells have a 20% larger Area of Effect, but now additionally cost health equal to 35% of their mana cost.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：血咒
技能范围提升20%，但是现在还会消耗生命值，数值为魔法消耗的35%。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Blood Invocation
 Spells have a 20% larger Area of Effect, but now additionally cost health equal to 25% of their mana cost.

技能范围提升20%，但是现在还会消耗生命值，数值为魔法消耗的25%。

被动：欺诈
最高基础攻击力提升6点。在计算佩戴者针对正补的基础伤害或小兵赏金时，数值会计算2次，并取较高值。

after.descriptionEn:

Increases your base damage maximum by 8. When calculating your base damage or creep bounty from last hits, the value is computed 2 times and the highest value is taken.

after.descriptionEn:

Reduce your own movement speed by 20 to provide a 180 physical damage barrier to allied player controlled targets in a 800 unit radius. Lasts for 6 seconds.

你的移动速度降低20，向800范围内玩家控制的友方目标提供一个180点物理伤害护盾。持续6秒。

after.descriptionZh:

 Enter into an insect form for 5 seconds, increasing magic resistance by 50% and movement speed by 20%. While an insect, your size is decreased and your armor is reduced by 45%.
before.descriptionZh:

进入昆虫形态，持续5秒，魔法抗性提升50%，移动速度提升20%。在昆虫形态下模型大小减少，护甲减少45%。

after.descriptionZh:

after.descriptionZh:
主动：飞天之幻
提供60%减速抗性、相位移动和40%闪避，持续6.5秒。

before.descriptionEn:
Active: Bloodthirst
 Gain 15% base damage and 30 attack speed for 6 seconds.

Passive: Bloodrush
Enemy heroes dying within 1500 units reset the cooldown of Bloodthirst.
before.descriptionZh:
主动：嗜血渴望
获得15%基础攻击力，30攻击速度，持续6秒。

被动：鲜血之激
只要敌方英雄在1500范围内阵亡，嗜血渴望的冷却时间就会重置。

after.descriptionEn:
Active: Bloodthirst
 Gain 15% base damage and 30 attack speed for 9 seconds.

Passive: Bloodrush
Enemy heroes dying within 1500 units reset the cooldown of Bloodthirst.
after.descriptionZh:
主动：嗜血渴望
获得15%基础攻击力，30攻击速度，持续9秒。

被动：鲜血之激
只要敌方英雄在1500范围内阵亡，嗜血渴望的冷却时间就会重置。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Salvo
20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 10 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：齐鸣
施放技能使用的20%魔法消耗会在10秒内恢复。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Salvo
20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 8 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：齐鸣
施放技能使用的20%魔法消耗会在8秒内恢复。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Linger
 30% of incoming damage is delayed over 5 seconds.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：延缓
承受伤害的30%会延迟到5秒内施加。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Linger
 30% of incoming damage is delayed over 8 seconds.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：延缓
承受伤害的30%会延迟到8秒内施加。

before.descriptionEn:
Toggle: Transmogrify
 Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by 12 and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

Rocks: increase armor by 3 and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.
before.descriptionZh:
切换：变幻
切换会使小包里的东西在羽毛和石头之间变换。

羽毛：移动速度提升12，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果提升30%。

石头：提升3点护甲，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果减少30%。

after.descriptionEn:
Toggle: Transmogrify
 Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by 15 and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

Rocks: increase armor by 5 and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.
after.descriptionZh:
切换：变幻
切换会使小包里的东西在羽毛和石头之间变换。

羽毛：移动速度提升15，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果提升30%。

石头：提升5点护甲，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果减少30%。

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Balance
 Gain 7% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and 6% spell amplification for every ability on cooldown.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：均衡
每个不在冷却的英雄技能提供7%魔法消耗降低，每个在冷却的技能提供6%技能增强。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Balance
 Gain 7% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and 9% Spell Lifesteal for every ability on cooldown.
after.descriptionZh:
Passive: Balance
 Gain 7% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and 9% Spell Lifesteal for every ability on cooldown.

before.descriptionEn:
Passive: Spellover
 Dealing 200 spell damage to an enemy causes them to overheat and deal damage to their allies in a 300 unit radius. Hero targets deal 80 damage to their allies, other targets deal 20 damage.
before.descriptionZh:
被动：法术外溢
对一个敌人造成200点技能伤害就会对其附近300范围内的友军造成伤害。英雄目标对其友军造成80点伤害，其他目标造成20点伤害。

after.descriptionEn:
Passive: Spellover
 Dealing 150 spell damage to an enemy causes them to overheat and deal damage to their allies in a 300 unit radius. Hero targets deal 80 damage to their allies, other targets deal 20 damage.
after.descriptionZh:
被动：法术外溢
对一个敌人造成150点技能伤害就会对其附近300范围内的友军造成伤害。英雄目标对其友军造成80点伤害，其他目标造成20点伤害。

before.descriptionEn:

 Increases spell damage dealt to player controlled targets by 9%.

对玩家控制目标造成的技能伤害提升9%。
